messages:
claire: FYI: onboard canary for chimaera-liteq:int8 shows parse rejects on funcall tests ~1.1% vs 0.04% fp16. Dropping a failing sample and quick notes. @diego @anya please triage.

 diego: Paste the raw model output + canary config?

 claire: Config: `model=chimaera-liteq:int8`, `batch=12`, `kv_cache=on`, `stream=true`, `retry_budget=1`. Raw output:

```
{"op":"fetch", "args": {"id": 42,}
```

Trailing comma and sometimes a missing final `}`. Parser: JSONDecodeError at char 87.

 anya: Sounds like token boundary/punctuation split. Is this correlated with context length or batching?

 claire: Yes 300-1500 token contexts spike failures. Lower batches & kv_cache off run much better.

 diego: Run mirror with kv_cache=false and microquant_pack=false + a tokenizer-pad variant (insert single token comment).

 canary-bot: mirror job queued: `mirror-1804009999-1` overrides {kv_cache:false, microquant_pack:false}. mirror-1804009999-2 queued: same + pad="//_p". ETA 8m.

 claire: Mirrored results: kv_cache_off -> parse drops to 0.03%. Pad variant -> remaining fails drop ~90%. json-healer postprocess repairs ~60% of leftovers but adds ~5ms median, ~30ms P99.

 anya: Short term: enable 1-token autopad in onboarding harness for int8 variants and run json-healer on-failure. Measure latency/cost; prefer autopad only if healed latency unacceptable. Also tag telemetry `canary:chimaera:int8:funcall-parse`.

 diego: Agreed. File an infra ticket to make padding policy runtime-configurable so we don't re-deploy canaries to toggle. Also attach sample diffs for quant team.

 claire: Done. Paused any rollout until next mirror shows healed>=90%. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/1804009999. Thanks all.
